title: Meetups
description: Schema for meetups data in the 757 Community site

url.description: The URL to the meetup's website or page

tags.description: An array of tags that describe the meetup

rssFeed.description: The RSS feed URL for the meetup's events

slug.description: Stable URL slug for this group's page. Stored explicitly rather than derived from the name so a group renaming itself does not silently break its URL.

description.description: Hand-written description of the group: what it is and who it is for. Distinct from metadata.description, which is a scraped Open Graph blurb truncated mid-sentence and should not be rendered as page copy.

city.description: Primary city the group meets in, e.g. 'Norfolk'

cadence.description: Human-readable meeting cadence, e.g. '2nd Tuesday, monthly'

status.description: Whether the group is currently holding events. Omitted means active.

imageUrl.description: URL to the meetup's cover image (must be a relative path starting with /images/)

title.description: The title of the meetup from metadata

description.description: The description of the meetup from metadata
